create_entry.title: Create content entry
create_entry.description: Create a new content entry in a model with the Write API. Every call creates a new entry (it is not idempotent); returns the entry with its new id. Use replace_entry to create-or-overwrite at a known id, or update_entry to change some fields of an existing entry.

body.name: ${name}
body.query: ${targeting}

model.description: The model's unique name (not its display name), e.g. page, symbol, blog-article.

name.description: The entry name shown in the Builder content list.

data.description: The entry's field values keyed by the model's field names, e.g. {"title": "Hello", "url": "/hello"}. Page and Section models may also carry `blocks` (the Visual Editor layout).

targeting.description: Targeting rules on the entry, each {property, operator, value}, e.g. {"property": "urlPath", "operator": "is", "value": "/about"}. Pages are usually targeted on urlPath.

model_id.description: The model's id; only needed when you want to pin the entry to a model by id as well as by name.

trigger_webhooks.description: Set false to stop this write from firing the space's webhooks (by default every Write API operation triggers webhooks); use it when a webhook handler writes back to Builder, to avoid an infinite loop.

replace_entry.title: Create or replace content entry
replace_entry.description: PUT a complete representation of a content entry at a known id. Properties you omit are deleted; if no entry has that id it is created. Returns the entry. Use update_entry to change only some fields.

body.name: ${name}
body.query: ${targeting}

model.description: The model's unique name (not its display name), e.g. page, symbol, blog-article.

entry_id.description: The content entry id, as returned in `id` when the entry was created or by the Content API.

data.description: The entry's field values keyed by the model's field names, e.g. {"title": "Hello", "url": "/hello"}. Page and Section models may also carry `blocks` (the Visual Editor layout).

targeting.description: Targeting rules on the entry, each {property, operator, value}, e.g. {"property": "urlPath", "operator": "is", "value": "/about"}. Pages are usually targeted on urlPath.

trigger_webhooks.description: Set false to stop this write from firing the space's webhooks (by default every Write API operation triggers webhooks); use it when a webhook handler writes back to Builder, to avoid an infinite loop.

update_entry.title: Partially update content entry
update_entry.description: PATCH a content entry: only the fields you send change, everything else is kept. Returns the updated entry. Use replace_entry to overwrite the whole entry, or publish by sending published=published.

body.name: ${name}
body.query: ${targeting}

model.description: The model's unique name (not its display name), e.g. page, symbol, blog-article.

entry_id.description: The content entry id, as returned in `id` when the entry was created or by the Content API.

data.description: Only the fields to change, keyed by the model's field names, e.g. {"title": "New title"}.

targeting.description: Targeting rules on the entry, each {property, operator, value}, e.g. {"property": "urlPath", "operator": "is", "value": "/about"}. Pages are usually targeted on urlPath.

trigger_webhooks.description: Set false to stop this write from firing the space's webhooks (by default every Write API operation triggers webhooks); use it when a webhook handler writes back to Builder, to avoid an infinite loop.

delete_entry.title: Delete content entry
delete_entry.description: Permanently delete a content entry from a model with the Write API. Returns {"message": "Success"}. To hide an entry without deleting it, use update_entry with published=archived.

model.description: The model's unique name (not its display name), e.g. page, symbol, blog-article.

entry_id.description: The content entry id, as returned in `id` when the entry was created or by the Content API.

trigger_webhooks.description: Set false to stop this write from firing the space's webhooks (by default every Write API operation triggers webhooks); use it when a webhook handler writes back to Builder, to avoid an infinite loop.

upload_file_from_url.title: Upload asset from URL
upload_file_from_url.description: Upload a file hosted at a public URL into the space's Asset Library with the Upload API (files must be under 100 MB). Returns the new asset's CDN url. Use upload_file_content to send the file body yourself.

url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the file to import, e.g. https://example.com/logo.png.

name.description: File name for the uploaded asset, including extension, e.g. hero.png.

alt_text.description: Alternative text for accessibility and SEO.

folder.description: Asset Library folder id to upload into (Asset Library > folder > pencil icon shows it); folders can only be managed with the main environment's key.

output.description: The upload result with the asset's CDN URL.

upload_file_content.title: Upload asset content
upload_file_content.description: Upload a file to the Asset Library by sending its content as the raw request body with the Upload API (under 100 MB). Suited to text-based files such as SVG, JSON or CSV; returns the asset's CDN url. Use upload_file_from_url for files already hosted online.

content.description: The file's content, sent verbatim as the request body.

content_type.description: The file's MIME type, sent as Content-Type, e.g. image/svg+xml, application/pdf, image/png.

name.description: File name for the uploaded asset, including extension, e.g. hero.png.

alt_text.description: Alternative text for accessibility and SEO.

folder.description: Asset Library folder id to upload into (Asset Library > folder > pencil icon shows it); folders can only be managed with the main environment's key.

output.description: The upload result with the asset's CDN URL.

delete_asset_by_id.title: Delete asset by id (REST)
delete_asset_by_id.description: Delete an Asset Library file by its asset id via the Assets API on cdn.builder.io. Requires the space's Public API Key as well as this private key. Use delete_asset for the GraphQL route that needs only the private key, or delete_asset_by_url when you only have the URL.

public_api_key.description: The space's Public API Key (Account Settings), required by this endpoint alongside the private key.

delete_asset_by_url.title: Delete asset by URL
delete_asset_by_url.description: Delete an Asset Library file by its URL via the Assets API on cdn.builder.io. Pass the asset URL without query parameters such as ?width=; it is URL-encoded for you. Requires the space's Public API Key too. Use delete_asset_by_id when you have the id.

asset_url.description: The asset's URL, e.g. https://cdn.builder.io/api/v1/image/assets%2F...; strip any ?width/height parameters.

public_api_key.description: The space's Public API Key, required by this endpoint alongside the private key.

run_admin_graphql.title: Run Admin GraphQL operation
run_admin_graphql.description: Send any query or mutation to the Admin GraphQL API (https://builder.io/api/v2/admin) with optional variables. Returns the raw GraphQL response with data and errors. Use it for fields or arguments the dedicated tools don't expose; prefer those tools otherwise.

body.query: ${query}

query.description: The GraphQL document, e.g. query { models { id name kind } }.

operation_name.description: Which named operation in the document to run, when it holds several.

data.description: Result keyed by the selected root fields.

errors.description: GraphQL errors, e.g. Private Key is invalid.

list_models.title: List models
list_models.description: List every model in the space (pages, sections/components, data models) with their kind, field definitions, targeting requirements and webhooks. Use get_model for one model by id.

body.query: query { models { id name kind subType helperText examplePageUrl pathPrefix hidden archived singleton repeatable isPage publicReadable publicWritable fields requiredTargets lastUpdateBy createdBy webhooks { url disablePayload customHeaders { name value } } } }

get_model.title: Get model
get_model.description: Fetch one model by its id, with kind, field definitions, targeting requirements and webhooks. Returns null when no model has that id. Use list_models to find ids.

body.query: query ($id: String!) { model(id: $id) { id name kind subType helperText examplePageUrl pathPrefix hidden archived singleton repeatable isPage publicReadable publicWritable fields requiredTargets lastUpdateBy createdBy webhooks { url disablePayload customHeaders { name value } } } }

create_model.title: Create model
create_model.description: Create a model (addModel). The body must contain name, kind and a fields array; returns the new model with its id. Use update_model to change an existing model.

body.query: mutation ($body: JSONObject!) { addModel(body: $body) { id name kind subType helperText examplePageUrl pathPrefix hidden archived singleton repeatable isPage publicReadable publicWritable fields requiredTargets lastUpdateBy createdBy webhooks { url disablePayload customHeaders { name value } } } }

fields.description: Field definitions, each e.g. {"name": "Headline", "type": "text", "required": true}. May be empty.

helper_text.description: Helper text shown for the model in the editor.

example_page_url.description: Preview URL used by the Visual Editor for this model.

settings.description: Any further ModelType properties to set, e.g. {"publicReadable": true, "hidden": false}.

update_model.title: Update model
update_model.description: Update a model by id (updateModel). `data` holds the properties to change; dotted paths are accepted, e.g. {"fields": [...]} replaces the field list. Returns the updated model.

body.query: mutation ($body: UpdateModelInput!) { updateModel(body: $body) { id name kind subType helperText examplePageUrl pathPrefix hidden archived singleton repeatable isPage publicReadable publicWritable fields requiredTargets lastUpdateBy createdBy webhooks { url disablePayload customHeaders { name value } } } }

delete_model.title: Delete model
delete_model.description: Delete a model by id (deleteModel). Not reversible: the model's content entries become unreachable. Returns null data on success.

body.query: mutation ($id: String!) { deleteModel(id: $id) { id name } }

list_folders.title: List content folders
list_folders.description: List all content folders in the space with their content entry ids, parent folder and archived flag. Use get_folder for one folder.

body.query: query { getFolders { id name description archived createdDate entries parentFolder ownerId lastUpdateBy } }

get_folder.title: Get content folder
get_folder.description: Fetch one content folder by id with its entry ids. Returns null when it doesn't exist. Use list_folders to find ids.

body.query: query ($id: String!) { getFolder(id: $id) { id name description archived createdDate entries parentFolder ownerId lastUpdateBy } }

entries.description: Content entry ids in the folder.

create_folder.title: Create content folder
create_folder.description: Create a content folder (createFolder), optionally nested and pre-filled with entry ids. Returns the folder. For Asset Library folders use create_asset_folder.

body.query: mutation ($input: CreateFolderInput!) { createFolder(input: $input) { id name description archived createdDate entries parentFolder ownerId lastUpdateBy } }

entries.description: Content entry ids to put in the folder.
Content entry ids in the folder.

update_folder.title: Update content folder
update_folder.description: Update a content folder (updateFolder): rename, change description, replace its entry list, move it or archive it. Returns the folder.

body.query: mutation ($id: String!, $input: UpdateFolderInput!) { updateFolder(id: $id, input: $input) { id name description archived createdDate entries parentFolder ownerId lastUpdateBy } }

entries.description: The complete new list of entry ids in the folder.
Content entry ids in the folder.

delete_folder.title: Delete content folder
delete_folder.description: Delete a content folder by id (deleteFolder). Returns true on success.

body.query: mutation ($id: String!) { deleteFolder(id: $id) }

list_assets.title: List assets
list_assets.description: List Asset Library files with id, name, url, MIME type, size, dimensions, folders and dates. Filter with a MongoDB-style query (e.g. {"type": {"$eq": "image/svg+xml"}}, {"folders": {"$in": ["FOLDER_ID"]}}; operators $eq $ne $in $nin $exists $regex), sort and paginate.

body.query: query ($input: QueryAssetsInput) { assets(input: $input) { id name url type bytes size width height folders createdDate lastUsed lastUpdateBy ownerId metadata } }

query.description: MongoDB-style filter over asset fields, e.g. {"type": {"$in": ["image/jpeg", "image/png"]}, "name": {"$regex": "logo"}}.

folder_id.description: Only assets in this asset folder.

environment_id.description: Environment id to read assets from.

delete_asset.title: Delete asset
delete_asset.description: Delete an Asset Library file by id via the Admin GraphQL deleteAsset mutation; needs only the private key. Returns true on success.

body.query: mutation ($id: String!) { deleteAsset(id: $id) }

create_asset_folder.title: Create asset folder
create_asset_folder.description: Create a folder in the Asset Library (createAssetFolder), optionally nested. Returns its id, which upload tools accept as `folder`.

body.query: mutation ($input: CreateAssetFolderInput!) { createAssetFolder(input: $input) { id name parentFolder } }

get_space_settings.title: Get space settings
get_space_settings.description: Return the space's full settings object (name, keys, plugins, targeting attributes, locales, editor settings, ...). Use get_space_id for just the id.

body.query: query { settings }

get_space_id.title: Get space id
get_space_id.description: Return the id of the space the private key belongs to. Useful before copy_space or generate_embed_token; use get_space_settings for everything else.

body.query: query { id }

list_users.title: List space users
list_users.description: List the space's users with id, name, email, role and last-active timestamp (ms).

body.query: query { users { id name email role lastActive } }

download_clone.title: Download space clone
download_clone.description: Read a clone of the space: settings, meta and models with their content, filtered by an optional content query (limit, offset, query, target, options, sort). Use it to copy a space's structure programmatically.

body.query: query ($contentQuery: ContentQuery) { downloadClone(contentQuery: $contentQuery) { settings meta models { id name kind fields content } } }

create_space.title: Create space
create_space.description: Create a new space under a parent organization (createSpace). Requires the ROOT ORGANIZATION private key on this connection, not a space key. Returns the new organization record and its private key; store it securely.

body.query: mutation ($settings: JSONObject!, $webhooks: [WebhookType!]) { createSpace(settings: $settings, webhooks: $webhooks) }

settings.description: Space settings, e.g. {"name": "Dev Environment", "description": "My dev space"}.

webhooks.description: Global webhooks to add, each {url, disablePayload, customHeaders: [{name, value}]}.

output.description: The created space and its private key.

copy_space.title: Copy space
copy_space.description: Duplicate a space (copySpace). Authorized by the source space's private key or the parent organization's; needs Organization Admin. Returns newSpaceId and the new space's private key.

body.query: mutation ($sourceSpaceId: String!, $name: String!, $includeUsers: Boolean, $skipAssets: Boolean) { copySpace(sourceSpaceId: $sourceSpaceId, name: $name, includeUsers: $includeUsers, skipAssets: $skipAssets) { newSpaceId privateKey } }

source_space_id.description: Id of the space to copy.

privateKey.description: The new space's private key record.

archive_space.title: Archive space
archive_space.description: Archive the space this private key belongs to (archiveSpace). The space stops serving content; treat as irreversible from the API.

body.query: mutation { archiveSpace }

generate_embed_token.title: Generate embed token
generate_embed_token.description: Generate a temporary (one hour) token that allows embedding a space within the given domain without exposing API keys. Returns token and expires (ms timestamp).

body.query: mutation ($claims: EmbedTokenClaims!) { generateEmbedToken(claims: $claims) { token expires } }

space_id.description: The public key of the space to embed.

domain.description: Full URL of the embedding site, e.g. https://mybuilder.example.com.

update_space_properties.title: Update space properties
update_space_properties.description: Update top-level space properties such as siteUrl (updateSpaceProperties). Returns true on success.

body.query: mutation ($properties: SpacePropertiesInput!) { updateSpaceProperties(properties: $properties) }

site_url.description: The site URL for the space.

update_space_editor_settings.title: Update editor settings
update_space_editor_settings.description: Update Visual Editor settings for the space (updateSpaceEditorSettings); only the flags you pass change. Returns true on success.

body.query: mutation ($settings: SpaceEditorSettingsInput!) { updateSpaceEditorSettings(settings: $settings) }

update_plugins.title: Update plugins
update_plugins.description: Set the space's plugin list (updatePlugins) with optional per-plugin settings, e.g. loadPlugins ["@builder.io/plugin-magento"] and pluginSettings {"@builder.io/plugin-magento": {"storeUrl": ...}}. Returns true.

body.query: mutation ($loadPlugins: [String!]!, $pluginSettings: JSONObject) { updatePlugins(loadPlugins: $loadPlugins, pluginSettings: $pluginSettings) }

list_webhooks.title: List global webhooks
list_webhooks.description: List the space's global webhooks with url, payload settings and custom headers. Use add_webhooks to append, set_webhooks to replace all, delete_webhook to remove by URL.

body.query: query { getWebhooks { url disablePayload customHeaders { name value } limitPayloadFields payloadFields { field } } }

add_webhooks.title: Add global webhooks
add_webhooks.description: Append global webhooks to the space (updateWebhooks); existing ones are kept. Builder POSTs {newValue, previousValue} to each url on content changes. Returns true.

body.query: mutation ($webhooks: [WebhookType!]!) { updateWebhooks(webhooks: $webhooks) }

webhooks.description: Webhooks, each {url, disablePayload?, customHeaders: [{name, value}], limitPayloadFields?, payloadFields?: [{field}]}. customHeaders is required (may be []).

set_webhooks.title: Replace global webhooks
set_webhooks.description: Replace ALL of the space's global webhooks with the given list (setWebhooks); webhooks not listed are removed. Returns true. Use add_webhooks to append instead.

body.query: mutation ($webhooks: [WebhookType!]!) { setWebhooks(webhooks: $webhooks) }

webhooks.description: Webhooks, each {url, disablePayload?, customHeaders: [{name, value}], limitPayloadFields?, payloadFields?: [{field}]}. customHeaders is required (may be []).

delete_webhook.title: Delete global webhook
delete_webhook.description: Delete every global webhook whose url matches the given URL (deleteWebhook). Returns true.

body.query: mutation ($url: String!) { deleteWebhook(url: $url) }

add_saml_provider.title: Add SAML SSO provider
add_saml_provider.description: Add a SAML identity provider to the space settings (addSAMLProvider). SSO must already be enabled for the space.

body.query: mutation ($settings: SAMLProviderSettings!) { addSAMLProvider(settings: $settings) }

rp_entity_id.description: Service provider entity id; defaults to https://www.builder.io, change only if your IdP requires it.

add_oidc_provider.title: Add OIDC SSO provider
add_oidc_provider.description: Add an OpenID Connect identity provider to the space settings (addOIDCProvider). SSO must already be enabled for the space.

body.query: mutation ($settings: OIDCProviderSettings!) { addOIDCProvider(settings: $settings) }

client_id.description: Client id used to validate the ID token's audience.

issuer.description: Issuer URL; its /.well-known/openid-configuration is used for discovery.

delete_auth_provider.title: Delete SSO provider
delete_auth_provider.description: Remove the authentication (SSO) provider from the space settings (deleteAuthProvider). Users relying on SSO lose that login route.

body.query: mutation { deleteAuthProvider }

set_custom_targeting_attributes.title: Set targeting attributes
set_custom_targeting_attributes.description: Replace every custom targeting attribute of the space (the locale attribute is preserved). Returns the full attribute list. Use upsert_custom_targeting_attribute to change one.

body.query: mutation ($attributes: [TargetingAttributeEntryInput!]!) { setCustomTargetingAttributes(attributes: $attributes) { key schema { type enum groups descriptions { name description groups } } } }

attributes.description: Attributes, each {key, schema: {type, enum?, descriptions?, groups?}}, e.g. {"key": "plan", "schema": {"type": "string", "enum": ["free", "pro"]}}.

output.description: The space's custom targeting attributes after the change.

upsert_custom_targeting_attribute.title: Upsert targeting attribute
upsert_custom_targeting_attribute.description: Create or update one custom targeting attribute (not locale; use the locale tools for that). Returns the full attribute list.

body.query: mutation ($key: String!, $schema: TargetingAttributeSchemaInput!) { upsertCustomTargetingAttribute(key: $key, schema: $schema) { key schema { type enum groups } } }

type.description: Value type, e.g. string, boolean, number.

output.description: The space's custom targeting attributes after the change.

delete_custom_targeting_attribute.title: Delete targeting attribute
delete_custom_targeting_attribute.description: Remove one non-locale custom targeting attribute from the space. Returns the remaining attributes.

body.query: mutation ($key: String!) { deleteCustomTargetingAttribute(key: $key) { key } }

output.description: The space's custom targeting attributes after the change.

set_space_locales.title: Set space locales
set_space_locales.description: Replace the space's list of locales (BCP 47 tags). Returns the locale schema. Use upsert_space_locale to add or describe one.

body.query: mutation ($locales: [String!]!) { setSpaceLocales(locales: $locales) { type enum groups descriptions { name description groups } } }

output.description: The locale attribute schema after the change.

groups.description: Locale groups mapped to default locale.

upsert_space_locale.title: Upsert space locale
upsert_space_locale.description: Add or update one locale, optionally with a display description and locale-group memberships. Returns the locale schema.

body.query: mutation ($locale: LocaleDescriptionInput!) { upsertSpaceLocale(locale: $locale) { type enum groups descriptions { name description groups } } }

groups.description: Locale group names this locale belongs to.

output.description: The locale attribute schema after the change.

groups.description: Locale groups mapped to default locale.

delete_space_locale.title: Delete space locale
delete_space_locale.description: Remove a locale from the space and clean up related groups. Returns the locale schema.

body.query: mutation ($locale: String!) { deleteSpaceLocale(locale: $locale) { type enum groups descriptions { name description groups } } }

output.description: The locale attribute schema after the change.

groups.description: Locale groups mapped to default locale.

set_space_locale_groups.title: Set locale groups
set_space_locale_groups.description: Replace the complete set of locale groups, each {name, defaultLocale}. Returns the locale schema.

body.query: mutation ($groups: [LocaleGroupEntryInput!]!) { setSpaceLocaleGroups(groups: $groups) { type enum groups descriptions { name description groups } } }

output.description: The locale attribute schema after the change.

groups.description: Locale groups mapped to default locale.

upsert_space_locale_group.title: Upsert locale group
upsert_space_locale_group.description: Create or update one locale group with its default locale. Returns the locale schema.

body.query: mutation ($name: String!, $defaultLocale: String!) { upsertSpaceLocaleGroup(name: $name, defaultLocale: $defaultLocale) { type enum groups descriptions { name description groups } } }

default_locale.description: Default locale for the group, e.g. en-GB.

output.description: The locale attribute schema after the change.

groups.description: Locale groups mapped to default locale.

delete_space_locale_group.title: Delete locale group
delete_space_locale_group.description: Remove a locale group and its memberships. Returns the locale schema.

body.query: mutation ($name: String!) { deleteSpaceLocaleGroup(name: $name) { type enum groups descriptions { name description groups } } }

output.description: The locale attribute schema after the change.

groups.description: Locale groups mapped to default locale.

set_space_breakpoints.title: Set responsive breakpoints
set_space_breakpoints.description: Set the space's responsive breakpoints in px (integers, at least 2px apart). Returns the saved breakpoints.

body.query: mutation ($breakpoints: BreakpointsInput!) { setSpaceBreakpoints(breakpoints: $breakpoints) { xsmall small medium } }

small.description: Upper bound in px of the small (mobile) viewport.

medium.description: Upper bound in px of the medium (tablet) viewport.

xsmall.description: Upper bound in px of the extra-small viewport.
